card.name: Start of instruction sentences in label sections
card.fires_on: The first word or so of a directive sentence at the start of a contraindications or dosage-and-administration passage, such as This, Apply, Avoid use, Only administer, or Do not co-administer. The word just before the drug name or the patient group appears.

modes.label: Contraindication openers
modes.description: Opening word of a contraindication statement about a drug or a patient group.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Newborn or Premature Infants<< This>> drug should not be used in newborn or

modes.label: Dosing instruction verbs
modes.description: Command verbs or linking words at the start of administration directions.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Only<< administer>> via oral inhalation using the AFRE

modes.label: Linking word before drug name
modes.description: Small words like of or for that come right before a drug name or condition in dosing text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that mean 'this/the' (该, 这款) while pushing down unrelated name pieces, so little useful output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the opening words of instructions in the contraindications and dosing sections of a drug label.
